audit_title: Li et al. Sentinel-1 100m to Native 10m Grid Geometric Registration Audit
source_processing_level: Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) / Single Look Complex (SLC)

native_grid_contract.polarization_channels: Dual-pol VV+VH (when acquired in 1SDV) or Single-pol VV (when acquired in 1SSV)

li_distributed_imagery_contract.polarization_channels: Single-pol VV only (VH channel discarded during dataset compilation)
li_distributed_imagery_contract.data_type: uint16 (uncalibrated scaled digital numbers / scaled backscatter)
li_distributed_imagery_contract.georeferencing_mode: 4 Corner Ground Control Points (GCPs / tiepoints) without projected GeoTIFF CRS

registration_error_quantification.boundary_edge_ambiguity: Human polygon digitizations at 100m spacing lack sub-pixel spatial frequencies present in native 10m SAR backscatter imagery.
registration_error_quantification.affine_resampling_residual_m: < 12.5m (within 1.25 native pixels using ESA orbit state vectors and GCP interpolation)

protocol_gates_for_evaluation.downstream_metric_guidance: Pixels within 50m of a phenomenon boundary must be reported separately or excluded from strict boundary concordance scoring to avoid penalizing models for predicting genuine high-frequency 10m morphology absent from the 100m annotation.
